CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Wednesday, February 8, 2023
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Axzel Roman, Vice Chairmember  Fabiola Hernandez,
Ana Rodriguez, Commissioner  Commissioner

  Grant Winford,
  Chairmember

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Planning Commission meeting was called to order on Wednesday, February
8, 2023 at 6:01 PM.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, gave a brief summary regarding the conduct of the meeting.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Vice Chair Roman.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  Commissioner Roman
  Chairmember Winford
  Commissioner Hernandez
  Vice Chairmember Rodriguez
ABSENT
  None
ROLL CALL
Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION
This is the time for the Planning Commission to discuss any changes in the order
of agenda items.

 A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
REGULAR MEETING
FEBRUARY 8, 2023 Page 1
  1.  Recommendation to conduct a public hearing, adopt Resolution No. 2023-001, a
  Resolution of the Planning Commission of the City of Hawaiian Gardens
  recommending approval to the Hawaiian Gardens City Council of General Plan
  Amendment PLNG 2023-001, (the 2021- 2029 6th Cycle Housing Element
  Update) and recommending approval of the Negative Declaration for the draft
  Housing Element.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, provided a staff report.

  Vice Chair Roman spoke.

  Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke.

  Commissioner Rodriguez spoke.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke.

  Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke.

  Chair Winford spoke.

  Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke.

  Commissioner Hernandez spoke.

  Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke.

  Chair Winford spoke.
  A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Rodriguez, seconded by
  Commissioner Roman, to close the public hearing and adopt Resolution No.
  2023-001, a Resolution of the Planning Commission of the City of Hawaiian
  Gardens recommending approval to the Hawaiian Gardens City Council of
  General Plan Amendment PLNG 2023-001, (the 2021- 2029 6th Cycle Housing
  Element Update).

  The Motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Roman, Winford, Hernandez, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0
  ABSENT: 0
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 4–0–0–0

PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
REGULAR MEETING
FEBRUARY 8, 2023 Page 2
  B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

 1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON
  THE AGENDA

  That the Planning Commission waive reading in full of all ordinances and
  resolutions on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the public
  agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading
  waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Rodriguez, seconded by
  Commissioner Roman, to adopt Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Roman, Winford, Hernandez, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 4–0–0–0

 2.  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting
  of Wednesday, December 14, 2022.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Rodriguez, seconded
  by Commissioner Roman, to adopt Consent Calendar as presented, in its
  entirety.

  The motion was Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Roman, Winford, Hernandez, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 4–0–0–0
 C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

There were no Discussion Items.

PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
REGULAR MEETING
FEBRUARY 8, 2023 Page 3
  D.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, mentioned that a Planning
Commissioners Workshop will be held March 29 – 31, 2023.

 E.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

 F.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Commissioner Rodriguez stated she’s happy to see construction around the city: gas
station, Holiday Inn, facade Norwalk Blvd.

Commissioner Hernandez stated she’s happy with the construction at the Holiday
Inn not making too much noise.

Vice Chair Roman thanked Public Works staff for cleaning up the city after the recent
storms.

Chair Winford requested a list of developments/projects; and a general outline on the
process for general plan update elements, before the end of the 2 nd quarter.

 G. ADJOURNMENT

The Planning Commission meeting was adjourned at 6:55 PM.
